_doc: Spec purpose files: what each spec/use-case is meant to do, the loop it runs, and why the community takes each talent the model would otherwise mis-value (from loop_audit.py). Roles: enabler (the loop does not work without it), control (positioning/safety that keeps the loop running), safety (deaths/emergencies), throughput, sustain, utility, filler (cheapest legal path to a deeper talent - the model may legitimately pick a different filler), avoid (harms the loop). 'encoded' says how the reason is expressed in the manual effect files; sources are the guides the reason comes from.

bm-leveling.purpose: The pet tanks, the hunter shoots: 'as Beast Mastery, your pet will take less damage and deal more damage, allowing it to hold threat more easily' (Icy Veins).
loop: Hunter's Mark, Serpent Sting, Auto Shot / Aimed Shot / Multi-Shot
Feign Death / Concussive Shot if the mob turns
constraints: pet threat is the safety mechanism: pet damage talents are survivability, not just DPS (model: pet_dmg_to_surv)
mana and pet health decide the downtime

Improved Aspect of the Hawk.why: 'A huge damage gain when it procs, making it a solid choice for both leveling and at Level 60.'

Improved Revive Pet.why: 'Hugely important for if your pet ever dies during combat and just to make it easier to cast.'
Improved Revive Pet.encoded: sustain per rank (downtime after a pet death)

Endurance Training.why: Icy Veins prefers Thick Hide (pet armor) over Endurance Training; both are tier-1 paths. The model values pet health at ~0.2%/rank of leveling time.

Unleashed Fury.why: 'Solid damage increases for your pet, which will also increase its threat generation.'

Ferocity.why: Same as Unleashed Fury: pet damage and threat.

Frenzy.why: 'One of the most powerful talents', increasing the 'pet's damage and threat immensely'.

Bestial Wrath.why: 'An incredible damage cooldown... what makes this spec viable at low gear levels at Level 60.'

Efficiency.why: 'If you plan on doing no PvP at all, take Efficiency' (else Improved Concussive Shot).

Lethal Shots.why: 'A strong damage increase' - low at leveling crit rates, taken on the way to Aimed Shot.

Mortal Shots.why: 'A solid damage increase' at 60; small at 5% crit while leveling.

Hawk Eye.why: Range: one more shot before the mob arrives and a wider kiting / dead-zone margin.

Bestial Discipline.why: +20% pet Focus regeneration (more Claw / Bite: pet damage and threat) and 50% of the hunter's regen while casting (beta); one point on the way to Bestial Wrath.

mm-raid.purpose: Aimed Shot / Multi-Shot / Auto Shot weaving with Trueshot Aura for the melee group; mana lasts the fight.
loop: Serpent Sting only on long fights
constraints: hunters are mana-bound in long fights: Efficiency is core (model: raid mana weight 0.5 for hunter models)
one hunter carries Improved Hunter's Mark for all

Efficiency.why: Mana on every shot; hunters run dry on long fights without it.

Hawk Eye.why: Preference point: 'one of you should take all 5 points in Improved Hunter's Mark instead of either Ferocity or Hawk Eye'.

Improved Hunter's Mark.why: 'Only 1 Hunter in the raid needs to use Hunter's Mark for all hunters to benefit from it' - raid attack power, not your own DPS.

Endurance Training.why: 'Improved Revive Pet vs. Endurance Training: personal preference and depends on how often you think your pet will die.'

Trueshot Aura.why: Brings trueshot aura to 4 others (a party aura: the hunter sits in a melee group of four others); worth classic-era: +2.8% per receiver, forever: +2.0% per receiver (buff_value.py).

melee-dps.purpose: Forever's melee hunter: Survival's melee talents (Savage Strikes, Predator's Edge with dual wield, Expose Prey, Lacerating Strikes, Counterattack, Strider Kick, Lightning Reflexes) with Marksmanship's Lethal Attacks, Careful Aim and Lone Wolf or Beast Mastery's pet talents.
loop: Hunter's Mark and Serpent Sting from range
Raptor Strike on the next swing
Mongoose Bite whenever a dodge or Expose Prey activates it
constraints: No community build exists yet: the model's shares are tooltip assumptions until the fight lab's melee rotation calibrates them
Counterattack needs Deterrence (1 point); Lacerating Strikes needs Expose Prey 2/2

Deterrence.why: Prerequisite of Counterattack; also the melee hunter's survival cooldown.

Survivalist's Discipline.why: -40% Deterrence and trap cooldowns: more Deterrence uptime for a hunter standing in melee.
